integrity: Infinite theorem follows from elementary run-statistics and simultaneous cyclic orbits. Finite standard-library checks are corroborating, not the infinite proof. The guiding references are publicly dated at or after 2018-04-12; the oldest listed first public source determines this date.
scientific_limitations: Binary labeled cyclic three-gram multisets only; no reversal/complement quotient, larger alphabet, higher k, noise, or linear-word spectrum. Claims are exact for all lengths, but independent scientific verification is not performed; remaining originality risk is an equivalent unindexed specialization.
title: Singleton cyclic binary trigram spectra: a run rigidity theorem and a rational census
